description_expanded: Plan your getaway today to Blues Beach Bungalow, a lovely home located in Navarre Beach! Escape to the quiet solitude in this lovely beachside community, perfect for long walks, bike rides, and lazy days at the beach. Near fantastic restaurants and fun shops, you’ll find everything you need and more nearby! Blues Beach Bungalow is a beautiful 3-story home with three bedrooms and two baths accommodating up to seven. A thoughtful floorplan reveals a main living area on the second floor with cheerful turquoise walls throughout. A large living room with high vaulted ceilings greets you upon entrance, offering a relaxing spot with a comfortable couch, chair, and a flat-screen TV. A corner nook provides additional seating and a lovely spot for morning coffee, while the kitchen features stainless steel appliances, loads of counter space, and a breakfast bar with seating for two. You’ll find everything needed to prepare delicious meals to enjoy at the dining table or on the furnished deck just outside. The master suite, featuring a queen-sized bed, a flat-screen TV, and a bathroom, also resides on this floor, while guest suites, one with a queen-sized bed and the other with a twin bunk bed, share a bathroom on the third floor. An open patio downstairs provides additional space for family gatherings, and a full-sized washer and dryer are additional conveniences to enjoy during your stay! Pack up a cooler, hit the beach less than a block away, and soak up the sun as the balmy breezes lull you to sleep. Cool off in the calm waters of the Gulf of Mexico, then head to nearby Juana’s Pagodas, a casual beachside bar known for fresh seafood and cool drinks. The kids might enjoy an outing to the Gulf Breeze Zoo, or a stroll down the Navarre Beach fishing pier to see what’s biting. You’ll find it all and more in Navarre Beach! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
